verdict.rationale: Recurring job scheduling is a fair question for a terminal app, but the evidence documents no cron, scheduler, or recurring-trigger feature in a-Shell. The `.profile` script runs only once when a window opens, and the relay notes no trigger-action rules surface exists. Apple Shortcuts compatibility allows one-off command execution; any recurring schedule would come from the host platform, not a-Shell itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
